title: Sequencer suite does not assert that abort reaches the solver agent
description:
The fake solver peer in test_agent_scripting_sequencer defines no AGENT_PLATESOLVER_ABORT, so no test asserts the abort sent to the solver slot, automatically selected or selected by select_solver_agent(). Code inspection shows the dispatch is by slot and correct; only a regression would go unnoticed. Pre-existing gap. Next: add the property to the peer and assert ABORT on the selected solver.

Imported from .factory/findings/archive/FND-20261102123603-6a7f-select-solver-agent-001.json (category: quality, blocking: no).
